EXPORT.description: Export Model to File (EXPORT). Exports the current model to a JSON file; the request body carries the destination file path as a string, which the handler opens for writing and passes to the export command.

Argument.description: Absolute file path of the destination JSON file to export the model to. The handler opens this path for writing (must be a valid, writable path) and then runs the export command. If a file-name path parameter is supplied on the route, only that single item is exported; otherwise the full model is exported.
